translations.web: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;
translations.bsb: See to it, brothers, that none of you has a wicked heart of unbelief that turns away from the living God.
translations.kjv: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
translations.asv: Take heed, brethren, lest haply there shall be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God:
